title: Robot baristas and K-pop dancers lead South Korea's physical AI boom
source_used: Nikkei Asia (paywalled; only the sub-headline, photo caption and first paragraph could be read)
key_facts: Entertainment venues featuring advanced robots powered by physical AI are spreading across South Korea.
Examples named are robot baristas and humanoids that dance to K-pop alongside humans.
Galaxy Robot Park, a robot-themed park run by Galaxy Corp., opened in Seoul in August 2026 and features live performances by humanoid robots.
Nikkei's sub-headline: startups are seeking revenue beyond manufacturing with public-facing services.
quote_evidence: Entertainment venues featuring advanced robots powered by physical artificial intelligence are spreading across South Korea, creating spaces where visitors can experience the evolution of AI through robot baristas and humanoids that dance to K-pop alongside humans.
Galaxy Robot Park, a robot-themed park that opened in Seoul in August 2026, features live performances by humanoid robots.
why_it_matters_hint: South Korean robot startups are looking for income from the public, not only from factories.
event_date: Trend piece of 11 Oct 2026; Galaxy Robot Park opened Aug 2026
notes: Paywalled: the pre-fetch gave 485 characters (headline, sub-headline, caption, first paragraph). Google News RSS found no other outlet carrying this Nikkei article; Yonhap, Korea Herald and others covered Galaxy Robot Park in August, but those are different, older stories and were not used. Headline-only entry built from the visible lines.
